task.original_goal: Add isolated temporary-fixture corruption regression tests for the existing compressed offline knowledge pack reader/checker. Cover missing or malformed gzip pack entries, invalid article references and clear failures; no Android runtime or shipped guide changes. Do not depend on unmerged PRs #22 or #23.
task.roadmap_source: docs/OFFLINE_SEARCH_BULK_ROADMAP.md S1/S5; pack integrity and honest failure diagnostics
task.implementation_hint: Add a separate stdlib unittest fixture harness for scripts/check_knowledge_packs.py; refactor checker only as necessary to accept temporary root paths without changing default CLI behavior.

acceptance_criteria: Using temporary directories and synthetic internal_draft article/manifest/gzip fixtures, verify a valid minimal pack passes the existing checker without accessing repository-generated assets.
Verify a manifest reference to a missing pack fails with a nonzero process exit and a diagnostic identifying the missing pack.
Verify truncated or invalid gzip bytes and valid gzip containing malformed JSON each fail nonzero with an actionable pack-specific diagnostic.
Verify a manifest entry whose article ID is absent from its referenced pack fails nonzero with a diagnostic naming the article ID; also cover a manifest/source ID mismatch.
Ensure tests are deterministic, standard-library-only, do not modify real content or generated assets, and clean up temporary fixtures.

Provide a narrowly scoped public read-only GitHub Actions test run on the isolated task branch; capture run URL, head SHA, exact exit status and test counts. Report any unexecuted integration checks as unverified.
excluded_scope: No Android runtime/UI or device claims
No shipped guide edits, editorial approval, or publication
No new third-party dependencies, network calls, production infrastructure or deployments
No reliance on unmerged PR #22 or #23
No changes to pack format, stable article IDs or normal valid-pack behavior
